Maya (partnerships): quick heads-up — StackSmith (partner) requested a one-click terraform quickstart that spins up a minimal Redwood inference stack on AWS and GCP. Want a short pairing sync to scope modules, marketplace packaging, and a smoke test. @Naveen @Jules? :wave:

Naveen (cloud-eng): I can pair on TF modules. Two quick clarifications: do partners need cross-account assume-role patterns included, or keep it simple for a marketplace sample? Also: opinionated VPC/subnet defaults or minimal networking?

Jules (solutions): Suggest splitting into two modules: `redwood_core` (serving infra, autoscaling hooks, kv/cache toggles) and `redwood_marketplace_wrapper` (packaging, listing metadata, license hooks). Core should be param-driven so partner can toggle deployment_mode: hosted | dedicated | private. :+1:

Samira (docs): I9ll own the quickstart README and examples. Can one of you paste a minimal usage snippet (vars w/ defaults) and a smoke-test command I can embed?

Naveen (cloud-eng): Minimal snippet below. Defaults are non-prod; callouts for required partner steps included.

```hcl
module "redwood_core" {
  source = "github.com/redwood-inference/terraform-modules//redwood_core"
  region = var.region
  instance_type = "g4dn.xlarge"
  enable_kv_cache = true
  public_subnets = var.public_subnets
  deployment_mode = "marketplace" # options: hosted, dedicated, private
}
```

Naveen (cloud-eng): Suggested smoke test: `terraform apply -auto-approve`, then `curl -sS https://${lb_dns}/healthz | grep -q \"ok\"` and a sample inference POST to `/v1/generate` using the provided sample API key in test mode.

ci-bot: CI: opened PR #412 in `partners/stacksmith-quickstarts` with initial module skeleton. Tests: lint  passed, fmt  passed, terraform-docs pending. Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/partners/pull/412 :robot_face:

Maya (partnerships): Action items: Naveen — finish module skeleton + variable docs by EOW; Jules — author smoke harness + run matrix (aws,gcp) for two sizes; Samira — draft README + quick runbook. I9ll confirm marketplace listing windows and required legal metadata with StackSmith PM. Drop progress updates here when PR/README ready. Thanks! :tada:
